title: Level 11: Android Internals and AOSP
description: Explain Android beneath the application layer by tracing processes, Binder, system services, rendering, threads, ART, memory pressure, power rules, and diagnostics.
plannedTopics: Linux process and thread identity, app sandboxes, Zygote specialization, system_server, framework services, Binder, ServiceManager, and authority boundaries
Launcher resolution, task and process selection, ActivityThread binding, Instrumentation, activity attachment, window creation, first frame, Loopers, Binder pools, coroutines, and deadlocks
View traversal, Compose phases, Choreographer and VSync, RenderThread, display lists, BufferQueue, fences, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, and end-to-end frame tracing
Week 47: ART, DEX, JIT/AOT, garbage collection, process importance, power and background internals, diagnostic tools, and interaction-trace capstone

project.title: End-to-End Interaction Trace
project.summary: Trace a screen tap through input dispatch, application state, rendering, SurfaceFlinger, and the physical display.

theme.mapMood: A systems map connecting framework calls to processes, queues, surfaces, and runtime state.
